name: – Nils Ušakovs – § 1 – Am 58
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 1. Considers that, in times of profound geopolitical and institutional instability, security threats, protectionist pressures, loss of competitiveness, budgetary pressure and societal challenges, a predictable, robust, citizen-centred, efficient and investment-oriented EU budget remains central to the implementation of the EU’s policies; recalls that the EU budget should respect the principles of subsidiarity, proportionality and sound financial management;
